content: I look at my history on Aristotle dashboard and I see some information I like, such as start time of project. (It would be nice to have queue entry, process entry, and process completion times, but I am not in a hurry for this.) I no longer see the complete input prompt, only abbreviations of it. How do I get access to the original prompt?

content: Hi @J. J. Issai (project started by GRP), it's located at the beginning of the task history at https://aristotle.harmonic.fun/dashboard/requests/UUID.
For me it just shows "project" on all recent submissions (shows part of the prompt on older submissions)

Pietro Monticone said:

Hi J. J. Issai (project started by GRP), it's located at the beginning of the task history at https://aristotle.harmonic.fun/dashboard/requests/UUID.

I do not understand your reply. When I go to the dashboard, I see a listing which includes an abbreviation or renaming from my original prompt. When I click on it I see several fields, three of which repeat the abbreviations, and two of them allow me to edit the abbreviation to rename the project, and show me only the abbreviation. Other fields show Aristotle's output and other information. I do not see the prompt information included in the tar ball, and nowhere do I see a place to click which gives me the full unabbreviated prompt. Before there was a button that said "Input prompt" which would lead to the information I wanted; now there is no such button nor obvious replacement. What do you mean by "beginning of task history"? Is there a thing that reveals a history of a particular task? I have explored the displays given behind [LOG] and [CODE] and am still not finding it.

content: Update: For an older project, I can see it behind the abbreviations if I want to edit it. FOr my project of three days ago, I don't: it just has the abbreviated version. (It would be nice to have the ([INPUT PROMPT]) button or functionality back, instead of what seems to be a one-line text-box substitute.)

content: Further Update: I am now seeing the expansion behind one of the fields that invite me to rename the project. Although I can work with this, it is painful when I have multiline prompts, and the only way to look at them in the dashboard is through a small one-third line text box. Can we make this not a rename project field? (I partly understand the rationale, but really what is needed is an INPUT PROMPT button which is aware of versions and revisions and additions of the prompt; perhaps an INPUT PROMPT HISTORY button?)

content:
further further update: I just ran a project (thank you) where the result is preceded by a version of my prompt. This is acceptable, but it leaves me wanting. Being able to have the Input prompt as a separate copyable object in the dashboard was a nice feature, and for my older projects it was there and now it is not.
I appreciate the work and services you offer. I am willing to continue using the product as is. If you want to make it really shine, consider restoring/enhancing the input prompt accessibility, perhaps including (a text version of) the input prompt as part of the project tarball.
